Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with Procurement to run through the DocuSign flow.

Internal note —

Petered technical confirmation for the performance tier:
- Kernel selection: we lock to the m16-optimized kernel family for the premium pool; that keeps steady p99 behavior even when sequence lengths vary.
- KV cache: we will prioritize Nimbus routes for hot KV entries when baseline commit is active; cold entries may be evicted earlier during burst.
- Autoscale: burst to 2x will spin up pre-warmed nodes within 60s for predicted scheduled batch jobs (if they provide the zap schedule). For unscheduled spikes, soft-burst to 1.5x within 30s, then scale to 2x up to 5 minutes.

Risk callouts: heavy, sustained 2x beyond 30 minutes will likely push down the p99 by 30–60ms even in the performance tier; recommend a short-term reserved burst add-on for Q4.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
